title: Booking and appointment scheduling website
summary: A site whose job is to convert visitors into confirmed bookings: real service availability on a calendar, a booking form, an explicit confirmation state, and self-service reschedule and cancellation.
defaults: Show real availability with a date and time-slot picker, not a contact form
Always end a booking in an explicit confirmation state
Keep reschedule and cancel as first-class self-service actions
risks: Booking reduced to a plain contact form
verification: Pick an open time slot and confirm a booking
Reschedule or cancel from the my-bookings view
See the provider schedule reflect the confirmed booking
site_goals: Minimize back-and-forth by showing real-time availability
Reduce no-shows with reminders and a clear cancellation policy

typical_views.name: Services list
typical_views.purpose: Show what services or providers are offered with a primary book-now action

typical_views.name: Service or provider detail
typical_views.purpose: Describe duration, price, and open time slots for one offering

typical_views.name: Booking calendar
typical_views.purpose: Pick a date and open time slot and enter customer details

typical_views.name: Booking confirmation
typical_views.purpose: Confirm the appointment with its summary, add-to-calendar, and cancellation option

typical_views.name: My bookings
typical_views.purpose: Let customers view, reschedule, or cancel upcoming appointments

typical_views.name: Provider schedule
typical_views.purpose: Let the provider see and manage upcoming appointments

common_components: calendar date picker with open vs. blocked slots
service card with duration and price
